headings: Standard Operating Procedures - Production Line A
Standard Operating Procedures - Production Line A

aligned_relations.subject: RULE-ST01-02
aligned_relations.object: reduce speed by 10% and notify QC

aligned_relations.subject: RULE-ST02-03
aligned_relations.object: increase >1.5 A above nominal sustained >5 min

aligned_relations.subject: RULE-ST02-04
aligned_relations.object: Monitor ST04_PACKAGING-SPD whenever ST02_SEALING-CUR triggers a WARNING.

aligned_relations.subject: RULE-ST03-02
aligned_relations.object: below 110 pcs/min - check for label jam. Below 100 (CRITICAL): halt.

aligned_relations.subject: RULE-ST04-03
aligned_relations.object: drops below 1.00 m/s without operator command

aligned_relations.subject: RULE-SRV01-02
aligned_relations.object: automatic controlled shutdown of all PLC nodes

aligned_relations.subject: RULE-WRH01-02
aligned_relations.object: inspect door seals and activate dehumidifier

aligned_relations.subject: RULE-CHM01-01
aligned_relations.object: TMP MUST remain between 10°C and 20°C. CRITICAL above 25°C - activate emergency ventilation and notify safety officer immediately.

aligned_relations.subject: RULE-CHM01-01
aligned_relations.object: activate emergency ventilation and notify safety officer immediately

aligned_relations.subject: RULE-CHM01-02
aligned_relations.object: HUM MUST NOT exceed 50%RH. Elevated humidity accelerates degradation of hygroscopic reagents.

aligned_relations.subject: RULE-CHM01-03
aligned_relations.object: Only personnel with hazmat training (technician/supervisor/manager role) are authorised to enter Chemical Storage.

aligned_relations.subject: RULE-CHM01-03
aligned_relations.object: UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS must be escalated within 2 minutes
